answers.ma_evidence:
There are no other pairs of the form $(x,y)$ with $x\ne y$ in the relation. So, for all $x,y\in A,$ we have

$$
(x,y)\in R\,\text{and}\,(y,x)\in R\,⟹\,x=y.
$$
